description: This file implements the MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc class and related factory functions for IPC communication related to media key capabilities in the Rialto client. It includes methods for creating IPC stubs, querying supported key systems, checking support for specific key systems, and retrieving key system versions.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
classes.description: Implements IPC communication for media key capabilities, including methods to query supported key systems, support checks, and version retrieval.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing instances of MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a new MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: getMediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IPC module and attaches to the IPC channel.

methods.name: ~MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Destructor that detaches from the IPC channel.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates the RPC stub for the media keys capabilities module.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported key systems via IPC.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported via IPC.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a specific key system via IPC.
